AuraRender__CoreEngine__ImportMap__Descr: The record of AURA's import map: the one prefix AURA's code imports the core library through. index.html's inline <script type="importmap"> must say the same; change both together when a new engine version is synced in (60__Dev__WebBuildUtils/AuraRender__BuildUtil__SyncCoreEngine__.py).
AuraRender__CoreEngine__ImportMap__Impor: PainterlyNPR v0.8.13 at 1fa7f2c (v0.8.10's Move Tool and wireable right-click menu, v0.8.11's panel icons (AURA keeps its own panel), v0.8.12's potted standards NPR_07_2021 and NPR_07_2022 with the PottedStandard generator, the Topiary style and an organic's own hand of the pen, and v0.8.13's ground cut in 72__Paper__SheetComposer for AURA 0.5.13's elevation viewports), copied from the commit (its lock says WorkingTreeClean true; other sessions' uncommitted engine files are left out, as the sync always does).
AuraRender__CoreEngine__ImportMap__Runti: The pin also holds what the engine reads from outside its modules (12__Data__AssetLibrary, 07__Data__MaterialRecipes, 03__Style__AppStylesheets): the engine finds them from its own files, and the host links its stylesheets from the folder above this prefix.
